title: Inverse Hom comparisons across the normalized restriction square
statement: Fix an ordinary NativeFrobeniusRingedModel A and a twisted action-site Presentation P. For every equivalence K from action-site modules to native Weil sheaves whose forward functor is A.toWeil P, put U equal to action restriction. There exist a square K.inverse followed by U isomorphic to native forgetting followed by A.E.inverse, a native inverse Hom comparison, and an ordinary inverse Hom comparison, such that their Hom square commutes with exactly P.hom on the restriction edge. This asserts neither ordinary tensor coherence, a coefficient-unit comparison, nor preservation of complexes.

proof.text: Normalize inverse_hom_comparison: after applying the forward equivalence and composing with the given forward Hom component, it is the counit at Hom followed by Hom of the source counit and target inverse counit. Expand the specified inverse comparison, use counit naturality and cancel the forward unit/counit triangle.

proof.text: Choose the square component as A.E.unitIso followed by the ordinary inverse image of K.counitIso. Counit naturality proves its naturality; the ordinary equivalence triangle gives E(square) followed by the ordinary counit equals the underlying native counit. Its inverse and inverse-counit versions follow by cancellation.

proof.text: Transport both normalized forward Hom comparisons with inverse_hom_comparison. Apply the faithful ordinary equivalence to the desired Hom square and postcompose with A.hom. Naturality of A.hom, followed by the inverse comparison normalizations, expresses both sides using the counits.

lean.statement:
theorem native_inverse_hom_square
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    (A : NativeFrobeniusRingedModel k₀ l X)
    (P : TwistedActionRingedSite.Presentation A.J A.s A.R A.a) :
    letI := P.category
    let U := P.modules.functor ⋙ TwistedActionRingedSite.forgetPairs
      (TwistedActionRingedSite.sigma A.J A.s A.R A.a)
    ∀ K : TwistedActionRingedSite.Modules P.coefficient ≌ ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X,
      K.functor = A.toWeil P →
    ∃ square : K.inverse ⋙ U ≅
        Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X) ⋙ A.E.inverse,
    ∃ nativeHom : Functor.uncurry.obj (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) ⋙ K.inverse ≅
        (K.inverse.op.prod K.inverse) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (R := P.coefficient)),
    ∃ ordinaryHom : Functor.uncurry.obj
        (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber) ⋙
          A.E.inverse ≅ (A.E.inverse.op.prod A.E.inverse) ⋙
            Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (R := A.R)),
      ∀ M N : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X,
        U.map (nativeHom.hom.app (op M, N)) ≫
          (P.hom (K.inverse.obj M) (K.inverse.obj N)).hom ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := A.R) (square.inv.app M) (square.hom.app N) ≫
          ordinaryHom.inv.app (op M.carrier, N.carrier) =
        square.hom.app (ihom k₀ l X M N)
